articles.title: NVIDIA董事会启动独立调查，CEO黄仁勋致歉并配合
articles.summary: NVIDIA董事会针对新闻报道提出的国家安全关切启动独立调查；黄仁勋致员工邮件道歉，并表示支持调查、全面配合。
articles.new_facts: NVIDIA董事会针对新闻报道提出的国家安全关切启动独立调查；黄仁勋致员工邮件为个人行为道歉、支持调查并承诺全面配合。
articles.limitations: 独立调查仍在进行，尚无结论；本报道依据黄仁勋致员工邮件。

facts.text: 黄仁勋在11月8日致员工的邮件中表示，针对新闻报道提出的国家安全关切，NVIDIA董事会已启动独立调查。

evidence.quote: Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation.

facts.text: 黄仁勋为对妻子不忠道歉，并表示对自己的行为承担全部责任；他表示支持调查并将全面配合。

evidence.quote: I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife.
I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused
I support the investigation and will cooperate fully.

bilingual.title_en: NVIDIA Board Launches Independent Investigation as CEO Jensen Huang Apologizes and Pledges Cooperation

sentences.en: In an email to employees on November 8, Jensen Huang said that NVIDIA's board of directors had launched an independent investigation into national security concerns raised in news reports.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋在11月8日致员工的邮件中表示，针对新闻报道提出的国家安全关切，NVIDIA董事会已启动独立调查。

sentences.en: Huang apologized for being unfaithful to his wife and said he takes full responsibility for his actions; he said he supports the investigation and will cooperate fully.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋为对妻子不忠道歉，并表示对自己的行为承担全部责任；他表示支持调查并将全面配合。
